goals: Verify that WordProblem correctly parses and evaluates mathematical word problems involving single or multiple arithmetic operations
Verify that WordProblem throws an ArgumentError when provided with unsupported mathematical operations or irrelevant questions
activities: Define a question asking to add 1 and assert the WordProblem answer equals 2
Define a question asking to add 2 and assert the WordProblem answer equals 55
Define a question asking to add negative numbers and assert the WordProblem answer equals -11
Define a question asking to add more digits and assert the WordProblem answer equals 45801
Define a question asking to subtract and assert the WordProblem answer equals 16
Define a question asking to multiply and assert the WordProblem answer equals -75
Define a question asking to divide and assert the WordProblem answer equals -11
Define a question asking to add twice and assert the WordProblem answer equals 3
Define a question asking to add then subtract and assert the WordProblem answer equals 8
Define a question asking to subtract twice and assert the WordProblem answer equals 3
Define a question asking to subtract then add and assert the WordProblem answer equals 14
Define a question asking to multiply twice and assert the WordProblem answer equals -12
Define a question asking to add then multiply and assert the WordProblem answer equals -8
Define a question asking to divide twice and assert the WordProblem answer equals 2
Define an advanced math question, initialize a WordProblem, and assert that calling answer throws an ArgumentError
Define an irrelevant question, initialize a WordProblem, and assert that calling answer throws an ArgumentError
